title: Predicting Time Pressure of Powered Two-Wheeler Riders for Proactive Safety Interventions
abstract: arXiv:2601.03173v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time pressure critically influences risky maneuvers and crash proneness among powered two-wheeler riders, yet its prediction remains underexplored in intelligent transportation systems. To address this gap, we propose MotoTimePressure (MTPS), a deep learning model combining convolutional preprocessing, dual-stage temporal attention, and Squeeze-and-Excitation feature recalibration, achieving 91.53% accuracy and 98.93% ROC AUC, outperforming six baselines, with only 172K parameters, 0.66 MB model size, and 0.21 ms inference on CPU. To validate and benchmark MTPS, we present a dataset of 129,209 feature windows from 153 simulator sessions by 51 experienced male PTW riders under No, Low, and High Time Pressure conditions. Each sequence captures 63 features spanning vehicle kinematics, control inputs, behavioral violations, and environmental context. Our empirical analysis shows High Time Pressure induces 48% higher speeds, 36.4% greater

translated_title: 预测动力两轮车骑手的时间压力以进行主动安全干预
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2601.03173v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：时间压力严重影响动力两轮车骑手的危险操作和事故倾向，但其预测在智能交通系统中仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MotoTimePressure（MTPS），一种结合卷积预处理、双阶段时间注意力和挤压-激励特征重新校准的深度学习模型，实现了91.53%的准确率和98.93%的ROC AUC，优于六种基线模型，且仅需172K参数、0.66 MB模型大小和CPU上0.21毫秒的推理时间。为验证和基准测试MTPS，我们提供了一个数据集，包含来自51名经验丰富的男性PTW骑手在无、低和高时间压力条件下进行的153次模拟器会话中的129,209个特征窗口。每个序列捕获了涵盖车辆运动学、控制输入、行为违规和环境背景的63个特征。我们的实证分析显示，高时间压力导致速度提高48%，加速度提高36.4%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级深度学习模型MTPS，通过卷积预处理、双阶段时间注意力和特征重新校准，实现了对动力两轮车骑手时间压力的高精度预测，并提供了大规模模拟器数据集以支持主动安全干预。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight deep learning model MTPS that achieves high-accuracy prediction of time pressure for powered two-wheeler riders via convolutional preprocessing, dual-stage temporal attention, and feature recalibration, along with a large-scale simulator dataset to support proactive safety interventions.
